title: Organiser news: Yemaneberhan Crippa and Shure Demise win the 2026 Paris Marathon podium
publisher: A.S.O. — Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris official news
claims: Men's 2026 podium: 1. Yemaneberhan CRIPPA (ITA) 2:05:18; 2. Berhane Tesfay TSEGAY (ERI) 2:05:24; 3. Abdi NAGEEYE (NED) 2:05:34.
Crippa is the first Italian man to win the Paris Marathon; the men's course record remains Elisha Rotich (KEN) 2:04:21 from 2021.
Women's 2026 podium: 1. Shure DEMISE (ETH) 2:18:34; 2. Goitom Geberew TIGIST (ETH) 2:18:42; 3. Megertu ALEMU (ETH) 2:19:52.
Demise's 2:18:34 is a new women's course record, beating the previous mark of Judith Jeptum KORIR (KEN) 2:19:48 from 2022.
Alemu had run 2:18:33 in March 2026; the organiser describes the 2026 women's race as a three-woman fight decided in the final kilometre.
